speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise; could you please tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when your symptoms began?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection). The sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise in a pregnant patient at 30 weeks gestation, specifically following the consumption of unpasteurized dairy products (ice cream), is highly suggestive of listeriosis. This condition can lead to severe complications for both the mother and the fetus, including sepsis and chorioamnionitis. Immediate initiation of appropriate antibiotic therapy is crucial.
